headline: Public hearings on special exception and variance requests at eight properties, including 1549 Tuttle Avenue and 17 Fawn Drive.
summary: The meeting will hold eight public hearings on zoning requests. The requests cover properties on Tuttle Avenue, Fawn Drive, Country Club Lane, Pieper Drive, Dudley Avenue, Gianotti Court, and Center Street.
items: #26-011: Special exception request by Gentile for 1549 Tuttle Avenue
#26-012: Variance request by Gentile for 1549 Tuttle Avenue
#26-013: Variance request by Westbrook for 17 Fawn Drive
#26-014: Special exception request by DeBaise for 45 Country Club Lane
